title: Goofy Dressed As Donald Duck Disney Halloween Plush
descriptionText: The product is a Disney Halloween plush featuring Goofy dressed as Donald Duck. This collectible item is part of Disney's franchise and is officially licensed by the brand. Made in China, this plush toy is perfect for fans of Disney and collectors of contemporary plush toys. It adds a fun and unique twist to the traditional Goofy character, making it a standout piece for any Disney collection.
